notes.title: State Management in Zoneless Angular
notes.description: Investigating modern state management patterns for zoneless Angular applications, focusing on signals and reactive primitives for Project Nebula.
notes.content: Research state management in zoneless Angular applications for Project Nebula. Need to explore RxJS patterns, Angular Signals, and how they work without Zone.js for change detection.

notes.title: CSS Custom Properties for Dynamic Theming
notes.description: Deep dive into CSS custom properties (CSS variables) to create a flexible, runtime-configurable theming system.
notes.content: Explore using CSS custom properties for more dynamic theming. This would allow users to customize colors, spacing, and other design tokens without recompiling styles.

notes.title: Digital Gardens: A New Paradigm for Knowledge Management
notes.description: The metaphor of 'digital gardens' as an alternative to traditional blogs - growing, tending, and nurturing ideas over time rather than publishing finished articles.
notes.content: The concept of "digital gardens" could be a great metaphor for a personal knowledge base. Instead of polished blog posts, content evolves organically, gets revisited, and grows over time.

notes.title: Particle Animation for Timeline Entries
notes.description: Implementing a dynamic particle burst effect when timeline entries appear to add visual interest and guide user attention.
notes.content: Implement a particle animation for the timeline entry sequence in the portfolio. Using Canvas API or WebGL for performance. Should trigger on scroll and create a sense of emergence.

notes.title: Responsive and Alive Portfolio Design
notes.description: Philosophy: A futuristic OS-style portfolio should feel dynamic and reactive, responding to user interactions with smooth animations and state changes.
notes.content: A futuristic OS portfolio should feel responsive and alive, not static. Every interaction should have feedback, subtle animations that make the interface feel physical and real.

notes.title: Understanding Modern Web Performance
notes.description: Comprehensive guide to web performance optimization including Core Web Vitals, lazy loading, code splitting, and resource prioritization.
notes.content: Learning about Core Web Vitals (LCP, FID, CLS), critical rendering path, and how to optimize bundle sizes. Exploring Lighthouse CI for continuous performance monitoring.

notes.title: Microinteractions in UI Design
notes.description: How small, delightful animations and feedback mechanisms can dramatically improve user experience and make interfaces feel more polished.
notes.content: Microinteractions are the secret sauce of great UX. Button hover states, loading spinners, toggle animations - these tiny details add up to create a cohesive, premium feel.
